Bookmaker column lineage note (William Hill): 1819 uses WHH/WHD/WHA; 1920–2425 use both WHH/WHD/WHA and BWH/BWD/BWA (BWH=Bet&Win per notes.txt) — for 1920–2425 the William Hill series to use is BWH/BWD/BWA + BWCH/BWCD/BWCA (verified populated); 2526 uses BWH/BWD/BWA + BWCH/BWCD/BWCA. Validator: keep WHH-series and BWH-series separate, never merge.

**CRITICAL semantics warning for Validator: football-data does NOT publish true opening odds. Its non-closing columns are Friday-afternoon (weekend games) / Tuesday-afternoon (midweek) snapshots — do NOT label them "opening".**

### True OPENING odds verdict: BLOCKED (no public verifiable row-level source)
- oddsportal.com: historically carried opening/closing, now behind Cloudflare/bot protection — could not verify from public fetch. BLOCKED.
- soccerpunter.com: odds movement history gated to Platinum members (paywall) — verified from page text this round. BLOCKED (paywall).
- Pinnacle official historical archive API: requires paid API key. BLOCKED (auth/paywall).
- The Odds API / RapidAPI historical odds endpoints (Pinnacle bookmaker): paid tiers only, not public-verifiable. BLOCKED (paywall).
- BetExplorer match pages (e.g. https://www.betexplorer.com/football/... per-match 1x2 pages): DO carry per-bookmaker opening and closing odds tables, but pages are JS-rendered (no plain-HTTP endpoint), per-match only (no bulk file), ~3040 pages would be needed for the eight seasons, and per-bookmaker lineups (Pinnacle/William Hill/Bet365 presence) per historical season NOT verified this pass. CANDIDATE, not verified — entered unresolved queue.
- Private Excel database of Pinnacle open+close (sportsbookreview forum): private contact-based, not publicly verifiable. NOT USABLE.
- schochastics historical football dataset: derived from football-data, no true opening. NOT USABLE.
- API-Football: excluded as bookmaker-odds source per request rule (never substitute). Soccerway / WorldFootball.net / RSSSF / official LaLiga: fixture/metadata sources only, no bookmaker odds. NOT USABLE for odds.
- Conclusion: **Bet365/Pinnacle/William Hill 1X2 opening and Bet365/Pinnacle OU opening are unavailable in verifiable public row-level form for all eight seasons. Do NOT substitute football-data pre-closing for opening.**

## Q2 — Matching keys, timestamp semantics, duplicate/conflict notes
- Keys: season (folder yyyy), Div=SP1, Date (dd/mm/yy), Time (hh:mm local Spain; absent 2018/19 — cross-reference fixture source for 18/19 kickoff times), HomeTeam, AwayTeam. Team naming: football-data La Liga names ("Ath Madrid", "Ath Bilbao", "Real Madrid", "Vallecano" = Rayo Vallecano, "Sociedad", "Las Palmas", "Alaves" no accent, "Espanol" no ñ, "Cadiz" no accent). Validator: normalise accents via explicit alias map, never drop rows.
- Timestamp semantics: Date is match date (local Spain); Time = kickoff. **2018/19 has NO Time column — kickoff times unavailable in this file for all 380 matches.**
- Duplicates/conflicts: each file one row per fixture; no duplicates in sampled rows. Cross-bookmaker value differences are intentional (different snapshots) — report all, never merge. Cross-bookmaker-column-lineage (WHH vs BWH) must stay separate.
- Coverage expectation: 380 fixtures per completed season (20 teams × 38 rounds). All 8 files report 760 display lines (~380 data rows + blank-line interleaving); discovered 8/8 files present. Exact row counts + dedupe check deferred to Validator (declared in audit/unresolved queue).

## Q3 — Residual 2018/19–2021/22 fixture metadata gaps (researched by parallel agent, all sources verified live this round)

### Scope note for Validator
The local 103-match supplement was not accessible in this environment, so a diff against it was impossible. What follows is the complete public reference frame for the wider eight-season inventory's 2018/19–2021/22 window: per-season club lists, temporary-venue facts (the highest-value residual gaps), competition-entry seasons, and the coordinate-source assessment. Residual = anything in this frame not already in the local supplement.

### Club lists per season (20 teams each; union = 25 clubs)
- 2018/19: Alavés, Athletic Bilbao, Atlético Madrid, Barcelona, Celta Vigo, Eibar, Espanyol, Getafe, Girona, Huesca, Leganés, Levante, Rayo Vallecano, Real Betis, Real Madrid, Real Sociedad, Sevilla, Valencia, Valladolid, Villarreal. Source: https://www.transfermarkt.co.uk/laliga/startseite/wettbewerb/ES1/saison_id/2018 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018–19_La_Liga
- 2019/20: same 20 minus Girona/Huesca/Rayo Vallecano, plus Granada, Mallorca, Osasuna. Source: https://www.besoccer.com/Competition/table/primera_division/2020 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019–20_La_Liga
- 2020/21: minus Espanyol/Leganés/Mallorca, plus Cádiz, Elche, Huesca. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020-21_La_Liga
- 2021/22: minus Eibar/Huesca/Valladolid, plus Espanyol, Mallorca, Rayo Vallecano. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021–22_La_Liga ; https://www.transfermarkt.co.uk/laliga/startseite/wettbewerb/ES1/saison_id/2021/spieltag/19

### Temporary venues in the window (only two found; four seasons' Wikipedia "Stadiums and locations" tables checked)
1. **Real Madrid → Estadio Alfredo Di Stéfano** (Madrid, Valdebebas, inside Ciudad Real Madrid). 2020-06-14 (first home game 3–1 vs Eibar) through end of 2020/21; returned to Bernabéu 2021-09-12 vs Celta (560 days away per AP). Reason: COVID empty stands + Bernabéu renovation accelerated. Coordinates: **40.4769°N, 3.6143°W** (= 40°28′37″N 3°36′51″W). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfredo_Di_St%C3%A9fano_Stadium (infobox coords + "Real Madrid CF (2020–2021)" tenant); https://www.si.com/soccer/2021/09/09/real-madrid-bernabeu-stadium-return (AP return date); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020-21_La_Liga (stadium table "Alfredo Di Stéfano[a]", footnote "Stadium used for games behind closed doors").
2. **Levante → Estadi Olímpic Camilo Cano** (La Nucía, Alicante province, ~60km from Valencia). Approx 2020-06 to late 2020-07 — final 6 home games of 2019/20; then first 2 home games of 2020/21 (Sep–Oct 2020) were hosted at Villarreal's Estadio de la Cerámica; returned to Ciutat de València on 2020-11-08 vs Alavés. Reason: Ciutat de València phase-1 renovation (new roof/lights/broadcast), COVID empty stands allowed the move. Coordinates: **38.60444°N, 0.12194°W** (Wikipedia infobox) — CONFLICT: a second value 38.60319°N, 0.1228°W exists from an earlier record (~150m apart); reported not merged, see unresolved queue. Sources: http://stadiumdb.com/news/2020/11/valencia_first_phase_of_levante_stadium_revamp_about_to_finish (final-6-homes at Camilo Cano + 2 homes at La Cerámica + 2020-11-08 return); http://stadiumdb.com/news/2020/07/valencia_levante_to_have_new_roof_by_october ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Estadi_Ol%C3%ADmpic_Camilo_Cano (infobox coords + "Levante UD (2020)" tenant + "temporary stadium ... during the final part of the 2019–20 La Liga season").
3. No other temporary moves in the window: Real Sociedad (Anoeta 2019–2021) and Osasuna (El Sadar) renovated while staying in their stadiums; post-COVID-resume 2019/20 games were played behind closed doors at each club's own ground. (Medium confidence; cross-check venue field per fixture if high confidence needed — unresolved #7.)

### Coordinate-source authority assessment
Official club/LaLiga stadium pages publish postal addresses + directions only (e.g. "Av. de Alejandro de la Sota, 28055 Madrid") — NO coordinates. De-facto standard: Wikipedia infobox (GeoHack), 4–5 decimal precision, crowd-edited (cross-check advised). Secondary: OpenStreetMap/maps.me (Di Stéfano GPS 40.47652,-3.6141844, ~40m from Wikipedia value — same-stadium agreement); latlong.net and commercial aggregators are address-derived (medium). StadiumDB/industry media: strong on renovation timelines, no coordinates. Conclusion: official channels never publish coordinates; use Wikipedia primary + OSM/latlong cross-check; manual review if sources disagree by >200m.


## Q4 — O_INTERVAL verdict and strict crosswalk (case_id + complete pre-match qimen_output.json)
- **Strict O_INTERVAL (true opening → closing): NOT feasible** — true opening unavailable for all eight seasons in any verifiable public source (see blockers above).
- **O_INTERVAL Shadow (earliest pre-match snapshot → latest pre-match/closing pair): FEASIBLE with labelled semantics** — for 2019/20–2025/26, each target bookmaker has a same-source pair: pre-closing snapshot (Fri PM / Tue PM) + closing. This is an earliest-available→closing interval, NOT opening→closing; Validator must label fields pre_closing and closing, never opening.
- 2018/19: Pinnacle-only pair (pre-closing + closing); Bet365/WH closing absent; OU absent; kickoff times absent → O_INTERVAL Shadow limited to Pinnacle 1X2 only for 380 matches.
- Strict crosswalk verdict: **NOT sufficient for a strict opening-based crosswalk** into local case_id + complete pre-match qimen_output.json for any season, because true opening odds are unverifiable. A labelled pre-closing/closing crosswalk is feasible for 2019/20–2025/26 (all three bookmakers, 1X2 + OU) and partial for 2018/19 (Pinnacle 1X2 only, no kickoff times).
